end.summary:
Counted sides of 2D shapes, including a rotated triangle; this was shown on a new-situation question.
Counted corners in simple shapes; corner counting is still being practised and needs checking next time.
Named triangles from their sides and corners in different positions; this was shown on a new-situation question.
Identified that an open shape with a gap is not a complete closed shape.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners and naming shapes when they were turned. Ayaan first wondered whether a tilted triangle was still a triangle, then used its three sides and three corners to identify it; corner counting is still being practised. At home, draw or find shapes in different positions and ask Ayaan to count the sides and corners without starting at the same point each time.
